item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import uno, glob
from com.sun.star.connection import NoConnectException
local_ctx=uno.getComponentContext()
resolver=local_ctx.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver', local_ctx)
for p in glob.glob('/tmp/OSL_PIPE_*'):
    name=p.split('/')[-1]
    url=f'uno:pipe,name={name};urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext'
    try:
        ctx=resolver.resolve(url)
        print('connected', name)
        smgr=ctx.ServiceManager
        desktop=smgr.createInstanceWithContext('com.sun.star.frame.Desktop', ctx)
        comps=desktop.getComponents().createEnumeration()
        while comps.hasMoreElements():
            doc=comps.nextElement()
            print('doc', getattr(doc,'URL',None), getattr(doc,'Title',None))
    except Exception as e:
        print('fail', name, type(e).__name__, str(e)[:100])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "DISPLAY=:0 python3 - <<'PY'
from Xlib import X, display, XK
from Xlib.ext import xtest
import time

d=display.Display()
root=d.screen().root
# Click D2 (center of first output cell under Unique Names)
xtest.fake_input(d, X.MotionNotify, x=465, y=257)
d.sync(); time.sleep(0.1)
xtest.fake_input(d, X.ButtonPress, 1); d.sync(); time.sleep(0.05)
xtest.fake_input(d, X.ButtonRelease, 1); d.sync(); time.sleep(0.15)
# Ctrl+V
ctrl=d.keysym_to_keycode(XK.XK_Control_L)
v=d.keysym_to_keycode(XK.XK_v)
xtest.fake_input(d, X.KeyPress, ctrl); d.sync(); time.sleep(0.05)
xtest.fake_input(d, X.KeyPress, v); d.sync(); time.sleep(0.05)
xtest.fake_input(d, X.KeyRelease, v); d.sync(); time.sleep(0.05)
xtest.fake_input(d, X.KeyRelease, ctrl); d.sync(); time.sleep(0.2)
d.sync()
PY"
